title: Propose bounded desktop recognized-menu miss guard
platforms: Desktop proposal; GUI and implementation pending
changes: Specify a reviewable desktop input unit for recognized battle-menu misses, with baseline, replay and platform acceptance gates.
validation: Inspected the existing event handler, mouse queue, recording frame latch, relevant upstream TODO and previous EUR modeled evidence; no new runtime or ROM access.
limitations: The proposal requires specific-unit approval and real GUI baseline; it does not establish a fix for unrecognized partial reveals or change runtime behavior.
